EXACT_NAME_MATCH.description: Exact normalized string agreement within 50 meters

KANNADA_TRANSLITERATION.description: Native Kannada script in OSM matched against Latin Overture name

PHONETIC_VARIANTS.description: Phonetic spelling variation common in Indian English commercial signage

MULTI_STRATEGY_OVERLAP.description: Candidates corroborated simultaneously by multiple independent blocking strategies

CATEGORY_ADJACENCY.description: Semantically adjacent cross-domain categories (e.g. Sustenance ↔ Hospitality)

CLOSE_SPATIAL_DISTINCT_NAMES.description: Close physical proximity (<= 15m) with distinct, non-matching business names

STRONG_LEXICAL_SIMILARITY.description: High string similarity (Token Sort Ratio >= 85) without exact name equality

LARGE_DISTANCE_CANDIDATES.description: Candidates generated via non-spatial strategies with distance > 50m

MISSING_OR_GENERIC_NAME.description: Pairs with null, unclassified, or uninformative short names

HIGH_DENSITY_HOTSPOTS.description: Dense commercial core markets (Chickpet, MG Road, Indiranagar) with high POI congestion

sampling_method: Stratified random sampling across 10 disjoint/ordered evidence categories
